release_notes:
Speed up the dashboard, order page, and catalog browsing

Pages were loading slower than they should, especially the order
page and catalog. A few lookups were scanning far more data than
needed, a logged-out visitor's browser was downloading the full
order catalog before being sent to the login page, catalog images
were all loading at once instead of as you scroll, and a memory
setting was wider than it needed to be. All fixed.
